hero.subhead: TruthLens is a forensic counter-deepfake browser tool. Real-time analysis of text, images, video and URLs — instant verdicts on what was made by humans, what was made by machines.

dashboard.title: Run a forensic scan.
dashboard.subtitle: Paste text, drop an image or video, or analyze a URL. TruthLens returns a verdict in seconds.
dashboard.drop_image_hint: Drop a PNG / JPEG / WebP, or browse
dashboard.drop_video_hint: Drop MP4 / MOV / WebM, or browse
dashboard.url_disclaimer: Public pages only · We strip scripts and analyze the visible text body.

verdict.scanning_sub: Examining frequency artifacts, anatomical inconsistencies, linguistic patterns…

history.label: // SCAN HISTORY
history.title: Your forensic record.
history.subtitle: Every scan run from this device. Anonymous and stored locally to a session id.

settings.label: // SETTINGS
settings.title: Configure your TruthLens.
settings.subtitle: Paste a webhook URL — we'll POST a JSON alert when a DEEPFAKE is detected. Slack, Discord, Make, Zapier and any HTTPS endpoint that accepts JSON will work.

how.label: // PROTOCOL
how.step1_body: Paste text, drop an image or video, or feed a URL. The browser extension lets you scan in-place on any webpage.
how.step2_body: Routed to GPT-5.2 for linguistic forensics or Gemini 3 Pro for image/frame-level visual forensics.
how.step3_body: Anatomical errors, frequency artifacts, lighting inconsistencies, cadence patterns — graded by severity.
how.step4_body: 0–100 synthetic-probability with a clear classification: HUMAN, AI, DEEPFAKE, or UNCERTAIN.

extension.label: // CHROME EXTENSION · v1.0
extension.subtitle: Right-click any image or selected text on the web — TruthLens overlays a verdict instantly. Works on news sites, social platforms, anywhere.

login.label: // ACCOUNT
login.subtitle: Email magic-link login is coming soon. For now your history is stored on this device.
